notes: New UPDATES page in the menu with every past update, and a what's-new message the first time you open a new version.
Fix: falling into the void now counts as one death instead of several.
Fixes: impact frames now stay on the kill when you turn the camera, and everyone can see Tether ropes (not just the player using it).
Staff tools: the owner can lock specific weapons, launch players, heal/freeze everyone and turn on low gravity; mods can slay, freeze, mute and make announcements; testers can jump to players.
Staff powers: mods and the owner can BRING players (or everyone) to them and switch maps; the owner can also KILL ALL and lock or unlock everyone's weapons.

AI turrets are now off by default. Staff (owner, mod, tester) can turn them on for a server from the pause menu; in practice anyone can. Turret shots can be parried with the shield, and turrets can be stunned (Nova, parries) and destroyed.
Menu pages (armory, global chat and the rest) now stretch to the right edge of the screen.

Five new maps (Coliseum, The Box, Thunder Dome, Tunnels, City), end-of-match map vote, AI turrets, music, controller support, killstreak counter, map build-in cutscene, global chat in the main menu, holstered healing, Tether airborne lock-on and wall blast, faster dash, and fixes: armory clipping, reload on death, falling off the map now counts as a death.

Pillars of God is far more dramatic: 1.6s wind-up with a closing ring of light and a map-wide charge sound, a three-layer pillar, shockwaves, a huge new impact sound, and impact frames for everyone nearby.
Weapon wheel back on the left, styled like the old menu (scroll + right-click). Minimap now shows the whole map, north up.
Radial weapon menu (mouse wheel, point with the mouse, right-click to equip). See who's online on each server before joining. Rebind every key in Controls.
Fix: chat no longer gets stuck if you click, shoot or die while typing.
Server chat (/) and global chat across all servers (Right Shift). Version check: mismatched game versions can't join. Other players' reloads are now visible. Manual reload on T.
Servers 3 and 4 now run the Training map (no cubes or targets). Server buttons show each server's map.
The owner can now kick and ban moderators (and testers, as mods can). Nobody can kick or ban the owner.
Impact frames now shade weapon blades and shields (lit, shadowed and outlined like the rest of the world).
Owner gold shield: press G to become invincible (server-checked); everyone sees the gold shell.
Rain of God now for moderators too. Key 0 hides/shows staff weapons. Rain of God and Pillars of God are unparryable (go through shields).
Everyone now sees every kill's impact frames (styled by the killer's weapon). Hitstop still only for the killer and victim.

Staff codes: OWNER_CODE (mod tools, owner weapons Rain of God + Pillars of God, gold OWNER title), MOD_CODE, TESTER_CODE (green TESTER title). Owner weapons also work in practice once a server has confirmed the code.
Moderators: enter the moderator code in Settings to get a MODERATION page in the pause menu (kick, ban, end match) and a [MOD] tag. The server checks the code.
4 online servers: pick SERVER 1-4 in Multiplayer (8 players each). A full server now says so instead of dropping you.
Fix: railgun lock-on was unreliable (and so the red locked-on warning rarely showed). Lock now updates every physics step.
Screen edges glow red while someone's railgun is locked onto you, stronger as their shot charges. Everyone (and the server) needs this version to play together.
Gatling and railgun lock on at any range (line of sight only); railgun bolt reaches across the map. Scatter has aim assist and holds damage further out.
Tether slam now one-shots anyone in the blast (shields and spawn protection still block it).

New online map 'Sprawl': huge irregular arena with 150 m outer walls, a walled hub, ring road and spokes to break line of sight. Minimap (top-left) that only shows players you can see. Tether pulls harder with more tension.
Every weapon has its own impact frames, scaled to how hard it hits. Railgun keeps the full one.
Railgun now fires a laser bolt that flies out and only hits when it arrives. Kills give you 30 integrity back.
Swarm rockets are way faster. Dummy targets removed (drones and ground targets stay). Huge new explosion sound after the impact frames.
Nova has no cooldown, launches you far higher and slams you down at top speed (stun needs 60% charge). Impact frames now have a rising implosion sound that ends in a big explosion.

Gatling now has a 30-shot magazine with a 1.6s reload. Shield cooldown 6s. Dash down in the air by looking down. Railgun has no damage dropoff. Parries strike back at the shooter: 20 damage and a 5s stun.

Big balance pass: every weapon rebalanced so none is best. Damage numbers show damage and distance. Damage dropoff and max lock-on range per weapon. Scatter is now a pump shotgun that can one-shot point-blank. Marks 1.5x for 3s, Nova stun 1.2s.
Smoother 3D impact frames (real shadows and lighting from the kill). About 20% faster overall. Tether can't be used to fly anymore (rope snaps after 3s). Much less steering in the air.

Hold your speed: dashes now stack up to 500 while you keep steering forward. New implosion-to-explosion kill frames with manga shading. Smaller Gatling lock-on. Blocking a hit resets the shield cooldown.
Block (Q) shield + parry, speedometer, sounds, warmer lighting, Nova air slam, Tether slam, Gatling lock-on, longer-range Scatter, and lots of fixes.
Online server: play over the internet (works on school Wi-Fi) with the new ONLINE SERVER button.
Lobby shows the right address (hides virtual adapters); clearer connection-timeout help.
Update pipeline test (no gameplay changes).
First release: multiplayer PvP, six weapons, auto-updates.
